question: How much behaviour can be extracted from the fixed 2,040-neuron MaleCNS-derived spiking substrate when integration time, readout scope and downstream learner are chosen from diagnosis, while separating substrate-mediated computation from direct input-neuron leakage?
fixed_substrate: unchanged MaleCNS v1.0 graph, LIF core, encoders, background/stimulus; no recurrent weight change, no added neurons, no topology change
environments: unchanged v1.4 target adapters (LaneGame catch/dodge horizon 24; historical 8x8 SnakeGame; v1.2 Pong horizon 144; v1.2 Flappy horizon 138)
rewards: original environment rewards; no additional shaping; no curriculum

seed_namespace.disjointness: v1.5 seeds in [1e12,1.5e12); v1.4 in [1e11,6e11); historical/dashboard < 1.2e10; neural +1e9 and behaviour +2e9 offsets remain inside each 5e9 purpose block
seed_namespace.note: validation purposes are never used by the suite or trial; confirmatory indices are rejected by seed_for

checkpoint_selection: within each run, evaluate every 16,384 transitions on 32 checkpoint_select episodes; keep the best (ties -> later); the dev score is then measured once on 100 dev_eval episodes. dev_eval never influences which checkpoint is kept.
optimizer: Adam(0.9, 0.999, eps 1e-5), gradient clip 0.5, BPTT chunk 16 steps from stored rollout states
budget_rationale: diagnosis: Catch/Dodge reach ~0.98 by 131k at 16 ticks; Snake/Pong/Flappy curves still improving and sensory-ceiling Snake budget-limited at 131k

hypotheses.catch: 16+ ticks with GRU/MLP policy reaches >=0.97 from the descending readout (diagnosis 0.98-0.995)
hypotheses.dodge: 16+ ticks reduces edge-lane errors; >=0.97 without targeted sampling (diagnosis 0.98-0.99)
hypotheses.snake: leakage-free readout at 16-24 ticks with GRU and longer budget yields substantially more food than the v1.4 descending baseline (1.1-3.3) and may approach the all-readout number without input leakage
hypotheses.pong: longer integration (16-32 ticks) with GRU reaches >=0.90 without input leakage (diagnosis 0.84-0.88 at 16 ticks)
hypotheses.flappy: restoring >=16 ticks restores >=0.605; 24-32 ticks and longer budget push toward >=0.80

stage_A.name: learner x integration time (descending readout, all tasks, always run)

stage_B.name: readout scope on the stage-A winner (all tasks, always run)
stage_B.leakage_rule: headline-eligible readouts exclude the 218 directly stimulated visual-projection input neurons (descending, nonvisual, cb_intrinsic, pooled). all-2,040, visual-only and sensory-only are pre-declared leakage controls: always reported, never selectable as the headline.

stage_C.name: conditional optimisation/budget/capacity, in order, one change at a time on the current best headline configuration; skipped for a task once its dev mean reaches the stretch target

steps.name: C1_longer
steps.rule: double transitions, only if the chosen checkpoint lies in the last 25% of training for >=2 of 3 seeds

steps.name: C2_capacity
steps.rule: hidden 256 / core 128 for MLP or GRU; skipped for linear

steps.name: C3_optimisation
steps.rule: diagnosis: lr 1e-3 helped Catch/Pong and hurt Snake/Flappy, so Snake/Flappy get an exploration (entropy) schedule instead

rescue.label: SECONDARY RESCUE PHASE
rescue.trigger: after stages A-C, best eligible headline dev mean below useful_performance
rescue.method: reference-controller imitation warm-start on 16,384 fresh imitation-seed transitions (4 passes, separate Adam 3e-4), then the best headline configuration's PPO on original rewards; warm-start transitions reported separately
rescue.reporting: separate; not eligible for the headline selection; locked and validated separately only if its dev utility exceeds the headline's

excluded_by_diagnosis.curriculum: v1.4 curriculum hurt and Flappy fails at target-task pipe precision
excluded_by_diagnosis.temporal_stacking: GRU memory already present; stack not selected

selection_rule: per configuration: 3/3 seeds complete and finite; every seed state-probe > 0.05 and greedy dominant-action fraction < 0.98; utility = mean - 0.25*population SD over seeds; highest utility wins; ties within 1e-12 prefer linear<mlp<gru, smaller width, fewer ticks, simpler readout, fewer transitions. Never a single best seed. If no configuration passes the gates the best stable one is used to continue escalation but is labelled and cannot pass validation gates silently.
validation_rule: after selected_configs.json is written it is committed BEFORE any validation. Each locked selection (headline, and rescue if locked) is evaluated exactly once: each of its 3 trained seeds' chosen checkpoint on 100 fresh validation episodes plus a validation_probe; no training, no reselection, no re-evaluation. Any further development requires a new plan version and a new validation block.
stopping: all tasks complete stages A and B, the conditional stage C and rescue rules are exhausted, selections are locked and validated once. No configurations beyond those enumerated here. Failures are preserved.
